intro: Final papers: the big ideas, key words and examples on one sheet. Keep it in your book and use it to revise (cover, write, check).

panels.title: Big questions
points: Your Biology paper is on Tue 11 May. If you could only revise one topic tonight, which would earn you the most marks and why?
Two brown-eyed parents have a blue-eyed child. How is that possible?
Only about a tenth of the energy at one trophic level reaches the next. Why is that the strongest argument for eating more plant food?
Two pupils know the same biology. One scores 6/6, the other 3/6 on a planning question. What might be different?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by what the hands of people have earned' (Ar-Rum 30:41). Ecology shows how human choices change the balance Allah placed in creation.
